finding.title: Check ref.mounted/State.mounted before touching state after await in onboarding async flows
finding.why: Riverpod 3 throws UnmountedRefException when a disposed Notifier's ref/state is touched, and Flutter throws on setState() after dispose(). OnboardingController is @riverpod (autoDispose); if the wizard screen holding it is popped while current.save(ref) (a DB-touching step save) is in flight, advance() resumes and unconditionally reads/writes state, crashing. bulk_mark_screen.dart demonstrably knows the correct pattern -- _loadPreExistingCompletions checks mounted twice -- yet _proceedToConfirmation and both branches of _executeBulkMark omit it after their own awaits, so backgrounding the app or hitting back during a multi-hundred-item bulk-mark write reproduces the same crash class.
finding.recommendation: Add `if (!ref.mounted) return;` / `if (!mounted) return;` immediately after every await that is followed by a state=/setState/provider touch, matching the pattern already used correctly elsewhere in the same files.
acceptance_criteria: a notifier/widget test that disposes the provider/widget mid-await (pump then pop before the fake repository's Future completes) passes without throwing
a grep-based Rule-0 checker (or the fixed custom_lint) flags `state =`/`setState(` appearing after an `await` in a Notifier/State method without an intervening mounted guard
